prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Kansas City?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single objectively “best” agency — the right one depends on your goals, budget, industry, and whether you need performance marketing, creative/brand work, B2B demand gen, SEO, etc.

That said, Kansas City is home to several highly regarded agencies (two notable, large ones are Barkley and VML/VMLY&R). Beyond those, KC has many strong midsize and boutique shops that specialize in digital, SEO, paid media, social, branding, and B2B marketing.

To give you a useful recommendation, tell me:
- What are your primary goals? (brand, lead gen, e‑commerce, awareness, PR, etc.)
- What’s your monthly/annual marketing budget?
- Industry and target audience
- Do you prefer a local agency or is remote okay?
- Any timeline or must-have capabilities (SEO, paid media, creative, Salesforce, analytics)?

I can then give a tailored short list (with specialties, ballpark pricing, and questions to ask each agency) or draft an RFP you can send to them. Which would you prefer?
